name: webgpu-tensorflow-component
description: HTTP front-end component for the style-transfer service — serves the UI at / and forwards POST /stylize over loopback TCP

scripts.generate:types: rimraf generated/types && jco guest-types wit/ -o generated/types
scripts.setup:wit: npm run fetch:wit && npm run generate:types
scripts.build:component: jco componentize dist/component.js --wit wit --world-name component --backend qjs -o dist/component.wasm
scripts.build: npm run setup:wit && npm run build:ts && npm run build:component
